Not added because only aggregators were available (or provenance-blocked pages): Phya Thai 7 Animal Hospital (Ari 087-087-0445, Bangna 096-993-9945, said 24 h by thailandstarterkit), Don Kaew Animal Hospital Chiang Mai (097-957-2519, 24 h per thailandnomads), Chiang Mai University small animal hospital (+66 53 948 031) and CMU local animal hospital (emergency 24 h tel. 053-037071 per cmhy.city copy of faculty text), PIPC Phuket (076 644 333), RTB Animal Hospital Phuket (076 213 464), Aura Pets Phuket (065 141 6964), Dr Film Animal Clinic Hat Yai (24 h phone calls), Metta Animal Hospital Hat Yai, Bangkok Pet Hospital, Pet Avenue, Ari Pet Hospital. pattayapets.com, phyathai7pet.com and other Pattaya clinics could not be opened (provenance block). Koh Samui, Hua Hin, Krabi, Mahidol university hospital: no usable official source found; still to do. Mahidol vs.mahidol.ac.th not opened.
